official_binding: Official accepted PDF first page links siyuanliii/masa. Pinned later main is not assumed identical to paper-release weights or local recovered code.
license: Root Apache2.0 fully read, copyright2024 SiyuanLi; no upstream files copied or executed.
dependency_binding: Read already-installed physical smoke environment source, not exact upstream paper-era dependency lock. No imports/inference/installation or claim that current upstream checkout was executed.
paper_read_scope: Main intro/relatedwork/method3.1-3.2.3, given-observation inference, experiments4.1-4.3 and conclusion5 text. Not all plots visually, references or supplement. No explicit main limitations section observed; task/metric limits below are audit interpretation.
original_task: Generalizable physical-instance association/zero-shot MOT and MOTS; not persistent unknown semantic category discovery.
model_inputs: Training: SAM pseudo proposal boxes and shared instance indices across two augmentations of the same raw image. Given-box inference: current image/boxes/scores plus per-video past appearance/box memory. Semantic detector branches/public detections are separate configurations.
model_outputs: 256D RoI association embedding and per-frame physical instance IDs, preserving supplied labels and confidence. No cross-video semantic anonymous category outputs.
losses: UnbiasedContrastLoss0.25 normalizes multi-positive mass with logsumexp; auxiliary cosine MarginL2Loss1 with neg_pos_ub3/negative margin0.1 and hard mining. Class-agnostic RPN+RoI object-prior distillation on SAM pseudo proposals is also active during offline training. Not semantic category contrastive supervision.
training_protocol: Docs/config: SA1B500K raw-image subset and SAM proposal box annotations, random with-replacement sampling of 200000 images per epoch; paired same-image augmented views, affine/MixUp/large scale jitter/crop/flip. GDINO released train config12epochs,8images/GPU,SGD0.08,momentum0.9,wd0.0001,clip35,warmup1000,decays8/11; val_interval4 against TAOVal. No actual dataset, annotation or weights opened, training performed or TAO supervision inferred.
online_or_offline: Offline instance-contrastive/distillation training; inspected tracker takes current frame and past memo. Default evaluator full-track category majority vote is retrospective.
causal_or_noncausal: MASA.predict processes frames sequentially and resets at frame0; current box/appearance association has no observed future feature use. This is static inspection, not actual GT/ID/future mutation proof. TaoTETAMetric defaulttcc=true uses completed tracks to rewrite all category labels, which cannot certify a causal category ledger.
state_memory: Per-video numeric physical IDs, latest box/label/score, EMA appearance and TTL10; no persistent across-video category memory, WAIT, reversible event bank or rollback.
evaluation: TaoTETAMetric accumulates per-video predicted rows, globally offsets physical IDs, applies default majority_vote, dumps rows then external TETA; optional external Base/Novel frequency reporting. Config uses TAOVal paths even where variable namedtest. Those assets were not read. No new TAOTest evaluation or validation-based model selection.
source_config_qualifications: R50 plug-and-play config given_dets=true/use_masa_backbone=true/unified_backbone=false uses mmdet QuasiDenseTrackHead; GDINO train config uses custom MasaTrackHead. Same RoI embed family does not imply identical config/training lineage.

Given four-column boxes are supplied an all-one score by forward; five-column boxes retain input confidence. This is not a foreground calibration certificate and must not silently overwrite frozen confidence.

with_cats is stored by inspected MasaTaoTracker, but association loop never references it; actual matching combines bisoftmax and cosine, optional spatial soft gating, then score-ordered greedy assignment.
Memo EMA uses (1-memo_momentum)*old+memo_momentum*current; TTL is numeric frame_id difference, not automatically elapsed real denseframes under annotated cadence.
Empty-detection return occurs before update/TTL eviction in inspected tracker; do not infer memory aged every empty frame or report an executed failure.

R50 config max_per_img50 and 1024 resize may affect detector branch; given-box branch bypasses internal detection. Whether local frontend already supplied cap50 must come from local frozen run, not this config alone.

Paper default SA1B implementation states SGD0.04/batch128; GDINO train config0.08/8perGPU with auto_scale_lr disabled/base_batch_size16. This is a recorded paper/config difference, not silently repaired.
Training loader builds pseudo instance_id from ann instance_id or ann id and single object category; actual annotations/proposal generation and exact local checkpoint lineage remain unverified.

Public-detection pickle or unified detector text-bearing branch can depend on supplied semantic classes; anonymous legal given-box branch requires independently qualified detector and lawful supervision.
Evaluator reads annotation at construction and may recursively clear its selected result directory; audit only, never executed against project outputs.

RandomSampleConcatDataset ignores requested index and resamples with replacement; get_data_info refers to self.dataset although storage is self.datasets. Static compatibility caveat, not a demonstrated runtime exception.
paper_limitations_summary: Instance similarity distinguishes individual objects, including same-category objects; useful physical continuity but not semantic category representation or cross-video category lifecycle. Public benchmark claims remain paper results, not local measurements.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Frozen physical-instance continuity can provide proposal history and current/past reliability cues. Strong instance separation does not repair semantic collapse; it must be evaluated separately from category discrimination and fragmentation coverage.
what_to_borrow: Lawful fixed observations, current-image RoI features and same-instance two-view continuity as a controlled physical/instance auxiliary, with Raw/semantic/instance disentanglement controls.
what_not_to_borrow: Treating physical IDs as category labels, cross-category negatives without semantic controls, retrospective category voting, supplied Novel vocabulary, or official paper numbers as local results.
requires_before_qualified_import: Exact local code/config/checkpoint and effective training provenance
Dense chronological frontend and external-only evaluator
Actual ID/future/GT mutation tests and downstream atomic category policy/memory
Fresh independent Train folds before method selection
